ticket.subject: Contacts export incomplete
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

Our contacts CSV export is cut off at 1,000 rows every time.

We can work around it by exporting in smaller filtered batches, but it takes a long time. This started after last week's release; it worked before.

A reply in the next few days would be great. Could you look into it?

Best regards,
Darius
